title: Workflow Specialist - Viral Vectors
description:
**Bring more to life.**
 Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?
   

  

 At Cytiva, one of Danaher’s 15\+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.
   

  

 You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.
   

  

 Working at Cytiva means being at the forefront of providing new solutions to transform human health. Our incredible customers undertake life\-saving activities ranging from fundamental biological research to developing innovative vaccines, new medicines, and cell and gene therapies.
   

  

 At Cytiva you will be able to continuously improve yourself and us – working on challenges that truly matter with people that care for each other, our customers, and their patients. Take your next step to an altogether life\-changing career.
   

  

 Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.
   

  

 The
 **Work Flow Development Leader** 
 is part of the India Commercial Organization and will be
 **Remote** 
 in nature with extensive travel to customer sites.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To**
* Customer\-Centric Strategy \& Business Growth: Leverage critical insights into customer workflows and manufacturing processes to develop tailored solutions that meet or exceed expectations. This approach not only strengthens customer satisfaction but also drives the expansion of Viral Vector Therapies (LV, AAV, RVV and Exosomes) by increasing market share in both existing and new accounts.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Technical Leadership: Work closely with Sales Specialists and Field Application Specialists to deliver comprehensive technical and workflow support. Build strong, trust\-based relationships with key stakeholders by demonstrating deep domain expertise and aligning solutions with customer goals and challenges.
* Market Development \& Strategic Execution: Proactively identify and develop new workflow opportunities within assigned territories. Execute business unit strategies across operating companies, manage sales pipelines, and provide accurate reporting on forecasts and opportunities to ensure consistent progress toward sales targets.
* Market Intelligence \& KOL Engagement: Gather and share insights on market trends, competitive dynamics, and customer needs. Maintain accurate CRM records using SFDC and cultivate relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) to enhance regional influence, support innovation, and drive adoption of new technologies.


**The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include**
* Bachelor’s or master’s Degree in engineering, biology, Chemistry or science related field.
* Minimum of 6 to 8 years of related experience in the field of Biotechnology, Lifesciences or Bioprocessing Industry
* Process knowledge about Processing of LV, AAV, RVV and Exosomes workflow.
* Understanding of product life cycle management and willing to learn new technologies.
* Willingness to travel extensively with in India or Abroad as per the business expectations.


 Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real\-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.
   

  

 For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

title: Specification Manager - Luxury Interiors & Projects
description:
**JSB is looking for someone who sells a premium material to architects, designers, developers and discerning homeowners — and wants a better one to sell them.** 




  





**About** 




  





 Founded in Kishangarh in 1993, JSB is one of India's largest importers and processors of natural marble. We buy blocks directly at the quarry across more than 40 countries, process them at our own facility, and hold over 400 colours in live inventory — Statuario, Calacatta, Brazilian quartzite, onyx, travertine and exotic stones.
 



  





 Architects, designers, developers and homeowners travel from across India to our Kishangarh Experience Centre to select their slabs personally.
 



  





 We deal in imported marble only. No Indian marble. No granite.
 



  





**The role** 




  





 We are opening Ahmedabad, and we are looking for the person who will own Gujarat.
 



  





 This is specification work. There is no dealer network to appoint and no monthly order book to service. Your job is to make JSB the material that gets specified — the name reached for when a project calls for something extraordinary underfoot.
 



  





 Your clientele is the full top end of the market:
 



  





 • Architects and design studios
 



 • Interior designers and turnkey interior firms
 



 • Luxury residential and hospitality developers
 



 • Project management consultants on premium projects
 



 • HNI homeowners building or renovating privately
 



  





 You will get JSB specified at design stage, hold the relationship through material selection, and bring your client to Kishangarh to choose their stone with their own eyes.
 



  





**What you will do** 




  





 • Build a specification map of Gujarat's top end — studio by studio, developer by developer, principal by principal — starting in Ahmedabad and extending through Gandhinagar, Vadodara, Surat and Rajkot
 



 • Get JSB specified at design stage on luxury residences, villas and farmhouses, high\-end apartment projects, hospitality, premium retail and flagship corporate interiors
 



 • Work both sides of a project: the design studio that specifies the material, and the developer, PMC or homeowner who signs for it
 



 • Run material presentations, place samples, and establish JSB inside design studio material libraries
 



 • Bring clients to Kishangarh. Marble is chosen with the eye. Your project becomes real when your client is standing in our slab yard, looking at the block.
 



 • Guide clients through selection: colour, veining, book\-matching, finish, and how a slab will read in the space it is going into
 



 • Own the project from selection through to delivery coordination with HQ
 



 • Maintain a disciplined pipeline: project, area in sq ft, stage, decision maker
 



  





**Who we are looking for** 




  





 You are most likely doing something close to this today at a luxury interiors or premium surfaces brand — Kohler, TOTO, Duravit, Grohe, Hansgrohe, Roca, Villeroy \& Boch, Artize, Cosentino, Caesarstone, Laminam, Häfele, Hettich, Asian Paints Beautiful Homes, Saint\-Gobain, Greenlam, or a premium lighting or decorative finishes brand.
 



  





 What matters more than the logo on your card:
 



  





 • 6 to 12 years selling a premium or luxury interior product into design studios and high\-end projects, with Ahmedabad and Gujarat as your working territory
 



 • A live relationship map you personally own — architects, interior designers, luxury developers, PMCs and HNI clients
 



 • You have sold a premium material against a cheaper alternative and won on design and value, not on discount
 



 • You can hold your own in a design conversation. You understand that when an architect chooses a material, they are choosing how a room will feel — and you can talk about it that way.
 



 • You can also hold your own in a commercial conversation with a developer or PMC on rate, quantity and delivery
 



 • You are comfortable in premium rooms: design studios, owner\-side site meetings, HNI drawing rooms
 



 • Fluent in Gujarati, Hindi and English
 



 • Graduate. A B.Arch or interior design background is a genuine advantage. MBA optional.
 



  





**Straight talk before you apply** 




  





 We would rather lose you at the advert than at month three.
 



  





 • There is no regional office or showroom in Ahmedabad. You work from the field, out of design studios and client sites. Telecalling, back office, inventory and processing all sit at Kishangarh HQ.
 



 • There is no dedicated company vehicle. Travel is reimbursed against actuals.
 



 • Clients buy by seeing the slab. A meaningful part of your performance is how many qualified clients you bring to Kishangarh.
 



 • The first 90 days are field\-first. Personal meetings, personally done.
 



 • Compensation is part fixed and part performance. The variable is uncapped and tiered by project value band, so specifying higher\-value stone pays you materially more.
 



  





 If you want a showroom to sit in and a dealer network to service, this is not your role. If you want to build a territory in your own name, for a house that buys its own blocks at the quarry and processes them itself, it is.
 



  





**What we offer** 




  





 • Fixed salary of 5\-6 LPA, based on experience and the strength of your existing network
 



 • Uncapped tiered incentive on project value, paid above threshold
 



 • Travel reimbursed at actuals, plus mobile allowance
 



 • A material with genuine range. Over 400 colours in live inventory, so you are rarely the one saying no.
 



 • Direct access to principal\-level decision making. We own the buying, the inventory and the processing, so you are never waiting on a third party to quote.
 



  





**To apply** 




  





 Email keshav.bangur@jsbstonex.com with the subject line: Specification Manager – Ahmedabad – \[Your Name]
 



  





 Answer these three questions in your email. Applications that do not answer them are not reviewed.
 



  





 1\. Name three architecture, design or developer clients in Ahmedabad you have personally worked with, and the person you deal with at each.
 



 2\. What is the largest single project you have personally specified? Project type and approximate area or value.
 



 3\. Your current fixed CTC and notice period.
 



  





 Applications are reviewed personally. If you are shortlisted, you will hear from us within five working days.

title: Manager - Customer Development
description:

 The mission of the L3 Customer Development Executive is to drive revenue growth through new customer acquisitions and solution framework design. The role focuses on nurturing leads from the discovery phase through to contract closure, specifically managing standard\-complexity deals. This specialist is responsible for identifying collaboration opportunities,, and ensuring that solutions align with client strategic objectives.
   

  

* Key Responsibilities
* Identify and pursue new business opportunities through self\-initiated outbound efforts, networking, and industry research.
* Qualify inbound leads and proactively move prospects through the sales funnel to onboarding.
* Develop tailored sales pitches and high\-quality proposals (GMP/C4M) that address specific client requirements.
* Maintain meticulous CRM hygiene, tracking all pipeline metrics and reporting progress to senior management.
* Liaise with legal and finance teams to ensure smooth contract empanelment and approval of the contract.
* Drive new logo acquisition across international and Indian markets, and lead participation in RFP processes to secure new business opportunities.
* Must\-Have Skills
* Consultative Sales \& Discovery: Proficiency in uncovering latent client needs using the BANT framework (Budget, Authority, Need, Timeline).
* Business Development \& Solution Selling: Prior experience in a Business Development, Solutions Consulting, or Solution Selling role, with the ability to align client problem statements with relevant solutions.
* Sourcing: Ability to independently identify, source, and engage relevant prospects within the defined ICP, leveraging professional networks, market intelligence, and targeted outreach to build a strong pipeline.
* Negotiation : Ability to navigate complex, multi\-threaded negotiations and influence outcomes at the C\-suite level for high\-value contracts.
* Solution Design \& Presentation : Skill in aligning Tatvic’s Cloud, Analytics, and Agentic AI offerings to create coherent strategic solutions.
* Interpersonal Communication: Strong ability to manage stakeholders and hold persuasive conversations with decision\-makers.
* Technical Literacy: Foundational knowledge of Google Analytics 4 (GA4\) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) product suites.
* ICP Network \& Market Exposure: Established network within the Ideal Customer Profile (ICP), along with prior exposure to the US market and its business environment.
* Good\-to\-Have Skills
* Certifications in Google Cloud Platform (Associate or Professional level), GA4 or Gen\-AI.
* Not\-a\-Fit Criteria
* Unable to work independently or take end\-to\-end ownership of standard\-complexity sales cycles.
* History of inconsistent quality in proposal drafting or failure to follow brand and naming conventions.
* Tendency to "go silent" or delay communication when encountering blockers in lead conversion.
* Avoidance of direct stakeholder communication or discomfort in leading client\-facing discovery calls.
* Pitch mode not a discovery mode \- talking features or pricing before asking diagnostic questions
* Our Culture \& Perks — Where Grit Meets Growth
* Competitive CTC: based on experience \& performance
* Medical Insurance for you and your family
* Return\-to\-Work Program for New Moms
* 1 Work From Home Day/Month — flexibility when needed
* 2 Birthday Leaves/Year — one for you, one to gift
* Monthly Engagement Activities — from game nights to town halls
* Inclusive Culture \& Equal Opportunity Employer
* 5\-day workweek — because personal time is non\-negotiable
